question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc6bdae030229145a568a8fa8db32902e2b980459a477d02761063302d03595a.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = Number of horizontal lines ⇒ 3

Here, as there are 2 same parts, therefore '3 × 2' = 6 triangles

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7de47a455e0e785ece21c2d9f433b571ebbea99eb63f38ffde6696ee166e27.png] 

Thus, total number of triangles are 6.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
